basis: Product-team preliminary values. Lighting, cooled hours and infiltration are cited in value_sources (2026-11-12); equipment allowances, people heat and the kitchen appliances are uncited placeholders.

value_sources.lighting_w_m2: 5 W/m² inside the house: the NCC lamp power density allowance for a Class 1 dwelling (NCC 2016–2019 Volume Two, Part 3.12.5); NCC 2022 lowered it to 4 W/m² (Housing Provisions 13.7.6, which does not apply in NSW). The larger is used: most houses in a set are older than NCC 2022 or in NSW. Garage 3 W/m²: the Class 10a allowance in NCC 2019 Volume Two.
value_sources.cooled_hours: NatHERS conditioning hours (nathers.gov.au, internal heat loads; ANSNAC appendices): living zones heated and cooled 07:00–24:00, bedrooms 16:00–09:00. The sun on a room's walls and glass counts in these hours; people, lights and appliances keep schedule_hours.
value_sources.infiltration_ach: 0.45 air changes per hour: CSIRO (2024) Air Infiltration of New Dwellings in Australia, Table 2, NSW two-storey new houses average 9.07 m³/h/m² at 50 Pa (the report uses this interchangeably with ACH50), divided by 20 (the usual conversion from 50 Pa to natural infiltration, Sherman 1987). NSW single-storey houses average 6.35 (0.32 ACH); the 2015 CSIRO study of new houses averaged 15.4 ACH50 (0.77 ACH), so older houses leak more.

default_glazing.source: NatHERS default windows (NatHERS fact sheet 'How do windows work in NatHERS', Table 1; NSW Planning Portal, BASIX DIY default window data): aluminium single-glazed clear. Used for a house window when no certificate gives its glass (decided 2026-11-12). Group A frames (hinged or projected: awning, casement, bi-fold) and group B (fixed or sliding) differ in frame share; a window whose type isn't known takes group B, the higher SHGC.

A.label: Aluminium A, single clear (hinged or projected)

B.label: Aluminium B, single clear (fixed or sliding)
